mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST < 590 and RSAFS < 365000) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
